SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 12

SELECT date_trunc('month', dt) m, c, count(*) n FROM d GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, st.store_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<900),
r AS (
 SELECT f.return_date, st.store_id, f.refund_net FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id<900),
rp AS (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' AND store_id<900)
SELECT (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s) sales_all, (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff, (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE store_id=999) s999,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM r) ret, (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rp) rpt_gross, (SELECT sum(returns_net) FROM rp) rpt_ret, (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rp) rpt_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) ret_dup_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1)) ret_dup_content,

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region AS region_now FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
sales AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS d, st.store_id, -r.refund_net AS amt, 1 AS rn
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
),
allrows AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets),
mapped AS (
  SELECT a.store_id, a.amt, a.rn,
         CASE WHEN a.d >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'CY' WHEN a.d <= DATE '2025-09-28' THEN 'PY' END AS yr,
         CASE WHEN a.d >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN a.d ELSE a.d + 371 END AS cy_date
  FROM allrows a WHERE a.d >= DATE '2026-05-04' OR (a.d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28')
),
clean AS (
  SELECT * FROM mapped
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND NOT (store_id = 129)
    AND NOT (store_id = 125 AND cy_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-15' AND DATE '2026-07-26')
    AND NOT (store_id = 119 AND cy_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-18')
)
SELECT c.region_now AS region,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr='CY' THEN amt END),2) cy_lfl, round(sum(CASE WHEN yr='PY' THEN amt END),2) py_lfl,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN yr='CY' THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN yr='PY' THEN amt END)-1),2) lfl_growth_pct,
  count(DISTINCT cl.store_id) stores
FROM clean cl JOIN cur c USING (store_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY lfl_growth_pct DESC

WITH x AS (
 SELECT st.region AS reg_asrecorded, f.sale_date, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE st.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT st.region, r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key WHERE st.store_id<900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT reg_asrecorded,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN sale_date>='2026-05-04' THEN amt END),0) cy, round(sum(CASE WHEN sale_date<='2025-09-28' THEN amt END),0) py,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN sale_date>='2026-05-04' THEN amt END)/sum(CASE WHEN sale_date<='2025-09-28' THEN amt END)-1),2) naive_pct
FROM (SELECT reg_asrecorded, sale_date, amt FROM x WHERE sale_date>='2026-05-04' OR sale_date<='2025-09-28') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC
